headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 8, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a thrilling 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Zac Thornton earning the win. In other action, the Toronto Blue Jays edged the Philadelphia Phillies 5-4, led by Josh Smith's strong performance, collecting 3 hits, including a home run, and driving in 1 run. The Cincinnati Reds fell short in a 3-5 decision to the Washington Nationals, while the New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 3-2.

Several key players will be sidelined due to injuries. The Tampa Bay Rays have placed second baseman Ben Williamson on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. The Seattle Mariners have placed right-hander Cole Wilcox on the 15-day injured list with a left oblique strain. The Minnesota Twins have placed right-hander Joe Ryan on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 5, 2026, with a left glute strain. The Cleveland Guardians have placed right-hander Slade Cecconi on the 15-day injured list with right arm fatigue. The Chicago White Sox have placed left-hander Chris Murphy on the 15-day injured list with a left flexor strain and catcher Joey Bart on the 10-day injured list with a fifth metacarpal fracture in his left hand. The Toronto Blue Jays have placed second baseman Luis Urías on the 10-day injured list with a right quad strain.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the acquisition of first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics have traded right-hander Seth Johnson to the Athletics for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins have traded right-hander Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-hander Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies have traded right-hander Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-hander Aiden May.
